_note: SOURCES ARE DATA, NOT CODE. Edit this file and the next sweep picks it up; no deploy. Every entry ships DISABLED, because a URL invented at build time is a 404 at run time and a watcher quietly fetching nothing is worse than one that is obviously off. Check each URL in a browser, correct it, set enabled to true, then run: node backend/tools/signals-check.mjs

_fields.id: short stable key, used for deduplication reporting
_fields.name: what it is, shown in the queue
_fields.org: the organisation the signal is ABOUT, when a source only covers one
_fields.url: the feed or listing page to read — an RSS or Atom feed is far better than a page
_fields.contactPage: optional: the organisation's own supplier or contact page, read to find the published route in
_fields.enabled: false until the URL has been checked by a person

name: A planning or consenting authority's decisions list
